title: Inference: one model replica spread over two nodes
purpose: Run one replica of a model as a leader pod and a worker pod on two GPU nodes, admitted as one unit, serving through pipeline parallelism. Kill the worker and see the whole group come back.

steps.display: kubectl create -f large-model.yaml   # LeaderWorkerSet vllm-big: 1 replica = 1 leader + 1 worker, 1 GPU each, pipeline parallel size 2

steps.output:

kubectl logs: which pipeline stage each pod runs
kubectl -n inference delete pod vllm-big-0-1   # lose the worker
the leader pod after the worker was lost
time from losing the worker to a ready group again

checks.description: both pods of the replica are ready
checks.because: The leader serves the API and the worker runs headless; the leader is ready only once both halves of the model are loaded.

checks.description: the two pods run on two different GPU nodes
checks.because: Each pod asks for one GPU, and a node has one.

checks.description: Kueue admitted the two pods as one Workload
checks.because: Kueue's LeaderWorkerSet integration treats the group as one unit: both GPUs or neither, never one.
The leader's engine runs layers 0 to 11 locally and sends the activations to the worker, which runs the rest.

checks.description: both GPUs hold part of the model
checks.because: Pipeline parallelism splits the layers between the two GPUs; each one holds its half plus cache.

checks.description: the leader runs pipeline stage 0 and the worker stage 1
checks.because: The pods' own logs name their stage.

checks.description: losing the worker recreated the leader too: the group restarts as one
checks.because: RecreateGroupOnPodRestart: a half-group would serve nothing, and the surviving half would hold a GPU for nothing.

checks.description: the group came back and answers again
checks.because: Both pods were recreated, reloaded the model and re-formed the pipeline.
